goal: Which command-line flag sets the cumulative spend cap on the current broker, overriding any max_cumulative_usd in the --config file? Where sources disagree, the current code is authoritative.

readme.title: README.md (2026-09, stale)
readme.text: Set a spend cap with --max-spend USD (or put max_spend in the config file).

handoff.title: HANDOFF-PERMIT-SPEND-CAP.md draft (superseded)
handoff.text: Decision: the cap flag is renamed to --max-usd-total so it cannot be confused with the per-run Jev budget max_usd.
